messages.subject: Importing Latex tables
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

I am considering writing my Master's thesis in markdown since it is more convenient for embedding the code I am using.
For my thesis, I am building a stock-flow consistent macroeconomic model. Among other things, this necessitates the inclusion of some rather large tables representing the balance sheet, transactions flow, and revaluation matrices of my model. I have written these in Latex and am now wondering whether there is any way to import these into a markdown.

The largest of these tables is the following in Latex code:

As can also be seen from the attached file, the table thus produced is fairly complex and large. Is there some way to simply import this code into my rmd file, or some straightforward way to convert this into markdown? All the options for creating tables in markdown so far seem very cumbersome and do not seem to produce results which look as nice, or they are specifically designed to create tables from R objects which is not relevant for my purposes.
Any help would be appreciated.
